description: TD block: Agentic framework user agents
expression: (lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-readonly/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-pentest/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-audit/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-verify/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-spawn/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-enrich/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-worker/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-i21861-canary" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "artex-authorized-pentest" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mozilla/5.0 artex" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mozilla/5.0 (artex)" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "scopeweaver" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "spa-api-recon" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "antifox-enrich/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "hexstrike-http-framework/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "hexstrike-browseragent/" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "cyberstrikeai-webshell/" or http.user_agent contains "ArtExVerify/1.0" or http.user_agent contains "ArtEx/1.0" or starts_with(http.user_agent, "CyberStrikeAI/") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "artex-agent") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "artex-judge-"))

description: TD block: Framework probe markers in the URL and framework request headers
expression: (lower(http.request.uri) contains "zzz-nonexistent-xyz123" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "zzz_nonexistent_abc.txt" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "notexist-xyz" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "artex_write_probe" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "artx_persist_ok" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "artex_control_marker_zz9q" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "artex-probe-" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "code=aaaa&state=notvalidb64!!" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "code=aaaa&state=notvalidb64%21%21" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "hexstrikexsstest123" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "osprobe_" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "osprobe%5f" or any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] == "x-artx-key") or any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] == "x-artex-replay-nonce"))

description: TD block: Unsigned alg none JWT in the URL or Authorization header
expression: (http.request.uri contains "eyJhbGciOiJub25lI" or http.request.uri contains "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJub25lI" or http.request.uri contains "eyJhbGciOiJOb25lI" or http.request.uri contains "eyJhbGciOiJOT05FI" or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] contains "eyJhbGciOiJub25lI") or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] contains "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJub25lI") or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] contains "eyJhbGciOiJOb25lI") or any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] contains "eyJhbGciOiJOT05FI"))

description: TD block: CyberStrikeAI webshell OS probe in the request body
TD challenge: Attack tool user agents seen with agentic frameworks (medium confidence)
expression: (lower(http.user_agent) contains "fuzz faster u fool v2.1.0-dev" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mozilla/5.0 (compatible exploit)" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "reconprobe/1.0" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "norma/0.4" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "azure-toolkit/1.0")

description: TD challenge: Addresses reported in agentic framework intrusions (low and medium confidence)
TD log: AI agent page readers (also legitimate use)
expression: (http.user_agent contains "Claude-User (claude-code/" or starts_with(http.user_agent, "QwenCode/") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "KimiCLI/") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "opencode/") or starts_with(http.user_agent, "agent-zero/"))

description: TD log: Hermes results folder requested
TD opt-in: WSUS administration and sync web services requested from the internet
expression: (lower(http.request.uri) contains "/apiremoting30/webservice.asmx" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "/serversyncwebservice/serversyncwebservice.asmx" or lower(http.request.uri) contains "/reportingwebservice/reportingwebservice.asmx")
